description_en: Attaches a disk to an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance
description_zh: 调用AttachDisk为ENS实例挂载数据盘
kebab_example: aliyun ens attach-disk --disk-id d-5saf13yy6sopmmg88mzsg0000 --instance-id i-5rr19av7tkpgi9os52ag10000 --delete-with-instance false --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDisk

parameters.description_en: The ID of the disk to be attached. The cloud disk and the instance must belong to the same node.
parameters.description_zh: 待挂载的云盘ID。云盘（DiskId）和实例（InstanceId）必须在同一个节点。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the disk to be attached. The cloud disk and the instance must belong to the same node
parameters.help_zh: 待挂载的云盘ID。云盘（DiskId）和实例（InstanceId）必须在同一个节点
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether the disk to be attached is released with the instance. Valid values:

- true: The disk will be released when the ECS instance is released.

- false: The disk will be retained when the ECS instance is released.

- If you leave this parameter empty, the default value is used.
parameters.description_zh:
待挂载的云盘是否随实例释放。取值：

- true：释放实例时，该云盘随实例一起释放。
- false ：释放实例时，保留该云盘，不随实例一起释放。
- 为空则表示默认为false。
